1	# frai-gate
2	
3	The **FRAI Gate** (Responsible AI Gate) for specs - part of [FRAI](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai).
4	
5	Every spec for an AI-touching feature must contain a complete `## FRAI Gate`
6	section - seven checks - and implementation doesn't start until the gate passes:
7	
8	1. Risk tier (EU AI Act-aligned; high-risk requires a named human sign-off)
9	2. Data provenance & privacy
10	3. Human oversight
11	4. Evaluation plan (numeric thresholds)
12	5. Bias & fairness
13	6. Monitoring & rollback
14	7. Transparency & incident response
15	
16	## Usage
17	
18	```bash
19	npx frai-gate init --ci                 # scaffold FRAI-SPEC.md + a GitHub Action that runs
20	                                        # the gate on every PR (works in any repo)
21	npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md         # deterministic validation - no API key needed
22	npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md --smart # + adversarial AI review of answer quality
23	npx frai-gate draft                     # read-only agent scans the repo and drafts a
24	                                        # gate section grounded in your actual code
25	```
26	
27	Also available as `frai gate ...` from the main [frai CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/frai).
28	
29	Exit codes: `0` PASS/WARN · `1` BLOCK · `2` usage/error - drop `frai-gate check` straight into CI.
30	
31	`draft` and `--smart` run on the [Claude Agent SDK](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk)
32	with read-only tools (`Read`, `Glob`, `Grep`) and need Claude Code authentication or
33	`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Override the model with `FRAI_GATE_MODEL` (default `claude-opus-5`).
34	
35	> **Privacy note:** `draft` and `--smart` send the repository content the agent reads to
36	> Anthropic's API. The agent is instructed never to read secret material (`.env`, keys,
37	> certificates, credential stores), but treat that as a mitigation, not a guarantee -
38	> think before running them on highly sensitive repos. `check` without `--smart` makes
39	> no network calls at all.
40	
41	## Programmatic API
42	
43	```ts
44	import { validateSpec, draftGateSection, smartReview } from 'frai-gate';
45	
46	const result = validateSpec(await fs.readFile('FRAI-SPEC.md', 'utf8'));
47	// { verdict: 'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'BLOCK', tier, findings, gateSection }
48	```
49	
50	The companion agent skill lives in
51	[sebuzdugan/frai-skills](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-skills)
52	(`npx skills add sebuzdugan/frai-skills`).
53

The `parseArgs()` function handles the `--ci` flag as a boolean flag:
- Any argument starting with `--` is treated as a flag

# Fix: frai CLI --ci flag not passed through to frai-gate

## Context

The `frai gate init --ci` command through the frai-cli wrapper does not create the GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/rai-gate.yml`, even though running `frai-gate init --ci` directly works correctly.

**Root cause:** The frai-cli gate command wrapper only captures positional arguments via `[args...]` in commander, but the `--ci` flag is parsed as an option separate from the positional arguments. The action callback only receives the `args` parameter (positional arguments), not the options/flags object, so `--ci` is lost when spawning the frai-gate child process.

**Evidence:**
- frai-cli (packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts, lines 737-755): Spawns `node gateCli ...args` where only positional `args` are passed
- frai-gate (packages/frai-gate/src/cli.ts, lines 87-97): Correctly checks `if (args.flags.has('ci'))` to create the workflow

## Solution

Modify the frai-cli gate command action callback to capture both positional arguments and the options/flags object, then reconstruct the full argument list (positional + options) when spawning the frai-gate process.

**File to modify:** `packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts` (lines 737-755)

**Changes needed:**
1. Update the action callback signature to accept the `options` parameter from commander
2. Convert the options object to command-line flag format (`--flag value`)
3. Pass both positional args and reconstructed flags to spawnSync

**Example transformation:**
- Input: `frai gate init --ci`
- Commander parses as: `args=['init']`, `options={'ci': true, ...otherOptions}`
- Reconstructed call: `spawnSync(node, [gateCli, 'init', '--ci'])`

## Verification

After rebuilding with `pnpm --filter frai build`:
1. Run: `node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js gate init --ci` in an empty test directory
2. Confirm both files are created:
   - `FRAI-SPEC.md` ✓
   - `.github/workflows/rai-gate.yml` ✓
3. Verify workflow file contains the GitHub Actions workflow definition

name: Responsible AI Gate
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  rai-gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      # Blocks the build until every Responsible AI Gate check in the spec is answered.
      - run: npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md
